surface.subject: Freight trip and trusted-contact coordination

direction.rationale: Narrow lifecycle repair of approved Phone and shared token consumption; retain exact approved light palette, type, rest silhouette and interaction contract
direction.signature: Named driver/contact/source update with explicit event time, adjacent to four separate fact rows and a stable permitted-action area; no fake chat capability
typography: One platform system-ui sans, regular/medium/semibold/bold; actual system rendering inspected at all target widths
Task labels16px+, supporting text14px+, headings24/30px, tabular times; product familiarity and fast local rendering override marketing display defaults
direction.layout: Mobile first single-task flow with clear labels, thumb-sized actions and persistent trip identity; wider layouts use bounded content and a supporting fact column. No nested card grids, decorative left rails or map dominating unknown facts. Shared blueprints specify every route.
direction.motion: 150–200ms state transitions only, visible-first, no page-load choreography; reduced-motion disables nonessential transitions
direction.density: Low density for driver actions, compact labelled event rows for facts, generous separation between tasks; high-priority state stays in first390x844viewport
direction.copyVoice: Plain Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese, sentence case, named action verbs, source-attributed reports, explicit unknown and recovery. Camiones/Caminhões, no jargon or implied emergency guarantee.
accessibility: Text contrast>=4.5:1 and boundary/focus>=3:1 measured at runtime
44px minimum touch targets with56px primary driver actions; no screen input required while moving to prevent escalation
Keyboard/focus restoration, semantic labels/live status, no colour-only meaning
Spanish/pt-BR expanded text, no horizontal overflow at360px; reduced motion
No route/participant/coordinate data in share metadata; generic noindex task pages
antiDefaults: No fake live map/green safety status
No generated testimonials, credibility badges or invented delivery
No decorative stripes, gradients, identical icon tiles or nested cards
No bot/composer/typing affordances without backend capability
No countdown owned solely by browser; unknown source age remains explicit

sources.reason: Actual locally updated skill governs accessible product workflows; source-status verified
New UI needs a concrete trip/contact identity; product task constraints override expressive marketing suggestions
Actual backend APIs and user brief determine actions and honest unavailable states

constraints: web/package and shared UI belong49; root backend/CI belongs44; no duplicate dependency files

Use existing /snapshot and forthcoming verified /status; do not wire provisional PR53 projection before Robert comments are resolved
No pretend login: real externally issuedOIDC or explicitly synthetic local test session only
Required utility metadata/noindex, generic share assets, graceful404; no external analytics
Every module needs rendered state/control/viewport evidence and independent acceptance before software completion
Review scope is component53 owned module/bridge and standalone synthetic harness only; no whole-app acceptance
